meta.title: Generic Druid spell list
rules: Spell included if any of its spheres is a major-access sphere, or a minor-access sphere and the spell is 1st-3rd level (2e PHB minor access rule, owner-confirmed).
Only spells whose Original Reference is PHB, PHB1, TOM, UA or HR are included.
id matches the spell id in priest-spells.json.
castingTime, range and savingThrow are copied from priest-spells.json.
